notes.title: Update 1.1.1 is HERE!
notes.notes:
Hello!

It's been nearly 2 months since the release of the Fur & Flames Update, and players have been super happy about it!

And since then, we've learned that Forgotten Mines was nominated at Gamescom Latam for "Best Game Brazil". It's a HUGE honor, so we couldn't be happier!

We're still working on the game, and we can't wait to show you what we have planned for the next Major Update...

In the meantime, today we have a new patch that fixes a lot of issues + 2 improvements!

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] skills with damage now show a "base power" modifier at the end of the descriptive text, in brackets. e.g.: [60].
[*] With the exception of Rasinok, who always offers the raven armor, the other ancient deities now offer a random legendary item when the pact is sealed.
[/list]

[h2]Bugfix[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixed bug that returned nullptr when a player tried to change the name of a character with a new species.
[*] Fixed bug when a square on the battle map become unasable when a character die.
[*] Fixed character unable to act after restart by wipe
[*] Fixed character dying when restarting if he was above water
[*] Fixed crash when earth elemental geo move out of map.
[*] -Fixed some items that did not get bonus from blacksmith.
[/list]

Don't forget to update your game!

notes.title: Fur & Flames Update is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello!

Today's the day! The Fur & Flames Update is FINALLY available, so time to go back to the fight and reclaim your mines!

[h1]Fur & Flames Update[/h1]

Two things I really wish there were more options for in the game were the playable species and the enemy variety. This update basically arises from this desire. 

Shortly after launch last July, I had the idea of the plasmoids. I had been playing with this idea for a while. I thought about doing an update entirely focused on them, a type of “Plasmoid Invasion!”. Plasmoid enemies and a playable plasmoid species would exist in this update. 

After reflecting a little, I came to beasts and elementals, and, honestly, I found these ideas to be more exciting for players. But nevertheless, I still wanted the presence of plasmoids in the update. I thought about expanding the lore of this universe a little, creating dwarves from the far north and a catfolk from the plains below the mountains of Dorvgrad. I also had decided that I would make at least 50 new items. Well, I ended up making 68 new items that will give players more options for different builds and compositions during their runs.

So yeah, the update got [b]quite big[/b], so I hope you'll like it!

Now, time for all the new stuff that this update is bringing to the game!

[h1]New Areas[/h1]

After finishing the game, the player will gain access to a choice of path for his run. The standard path is made up of the areas we already know (Verdant Halls, Muddy Tunnels, Ancient Prison and Gates of Hell). An alternative path can be accessed by the player. From the third area onwards, the player will find the traditional path again, that is, the new path will have a composition with two areas different from the standard path ([b]Beast Path, Elemental Caves[/b], Ancient Prison and Gates of Hell).

Those new areas bring:
[list]
[b][*] 12 new enemies
[*] 8 bosses[/b]
[/list]

[h2]Beasts' Path[/h2]

A forgotten and wild piece of Verdant Halls. Beasts of all sorts took shelter here throughout the centuries of abandonment. Atrocious animals and even magical beasts can be found, without much effort in searching. The place is a jungle inside the mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/b9f837bb07e166b4188bbbb3d1c85a54214e2b47.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/526a9a7d720d4e59f8a7ad6d9e07fc7f61ba7ada.png[/img]

[h2]Elemental Caves[/h2]

Rifts to the outermost elemental planes have been heedlessly opened for decades by the Elemental Cults of Dorvgrad. The result is an absurd population of Elementals of all types and powers roaming these caves. They say that in the most desolate parts of the Elemental Caves, some ancient elementals live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/8203c628e5a11eb560acfd1ca9d71887df6f502d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/835d2609b8f88e60a3a59145f1a384d06116bb5b.png[/img]



[h1]New races[/h1]

Those new races will bring even more replayability to the game!

[list]
[*]Northern Dwarves, who conquered the inhospitable tundras and mountains of the far north of the continent. They have grayish skin with different bluish tones and, in contrast, very red eyes. They are experts in the use of northern weapons and capable of great feats in battle.
[*]Plasmoid: Single-celled creatures from another dimension. It has a central nervous nucleus, its only organ, visible in the center of its head. It is believed that Plasmoids adhere to the humanoid form as soon as they enter the material plane.
[*]Jenguren Folks: Humanoid felines, slightly larger than humans. They occupy the forests and plains at the foot of the Dorvgrad mountains. They mostly worship Jenguren, to whom they attribute their creation and motivation in life.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/331b4fbba94d88ccee162d4b9c97ee75e4469880.png[/img]


[h1]New amulets[/h1]

There are 3 new amulets with this update:
[list]
[*][b]Claw Amulet[/b]: Increases damage dealt to Beats by 25%
[*][b]Core Amulet[/b]: Increases damage dealt to Elementals by 25%
[*][b]Northern Amulet[/b]: Increases damage by 25% when equipped with a Nortern weapon
[/list]


[h1]New equipments[/h1]

There are 68 new equipments (weapons, armors, accessories) in this update! Even more customization, we hope you'll have fun with them!


[h1]Bug fixing[/h1]

With this update we're bringing bug-fixing that you reported to us! Thanks again!!

[list]
[*]Fixed the issue where a tile was unusable if a character died after being attacked by a monster
[*]Fixed the gladiator class that automatically changed weapon after every loading screen
[*]Fixed a bug making the characters unusable when starting over after a wipe
[*]Fixed a bug allowing to absorb the stats of the items by restarting a combat
[*]Fixed the pop-up generated by the item added by the merchant's amulet, so now it correctly disappears after moving the cursor
[/list]

So yeah... this update is BIG, and hopefully players will be happy!

On a final note, more and more people are playing the game, and we couldn't be more proud! So, thanks for all the support you all have given us <3

notes.title: The Fur & Flames Update is coming!
notes.notes:
Hello Miners!

We hope you're okay! Wow, Forgotten Mines has been out for nearly 4 months now, time flies fast!

As promised in September 2024, we've been working on new content for Forgotten Mines, and while we're still working on it, we have some news about it!

[h1]The Fur & Flames Update[/h1]

After the release of Forgotten Mines and seeing how many players loved the game (THANK YOU AGAIN), we knew we wanted to keep working on the game to make it even better and bigger. Soo we got a BIT ambitious with this next update, but we hope you'll like it! 

The 1.1 Update for Forgotten Mines will be called "Fur & Flames Update" and will bring new races, new equipments, and new areas! But let us tell you a bit more about it. Please keep in mind that the update is still being worked on, so there are still some things that might be different from what we're announcing here, but the general idea will stay the same. 

[h2]New races[/h2]

3 new races will be available in the 1.1 update, increasing the roaster even more!
[list]
[*][b]Northern Dwarves[/b], who conquered the inhospitable tundras and mountains of the far north of the continent. They have grayish skin with different bluish tones and, in contrast, very red eyes. They are experts in the use of northern weapons and capable of great feats in battle. 
[*][b]Plasmoid[/b]:  Single-celled creatures from another dimension. It has a central nervous nucleus, its only organ, visible in the center of its head. It is believed that Plasmoids adhere to the humanoid form as soon as they enter the material plane. 
[*][b]Jenguren Folks[/b]: Humanoid felines, slightly larger than humans. They occupy the forests and plains at the foot of the Dorvgrad mountains. They mostly worship Jenguren, to whom they attribute their creation and motivation in life. 
[/list]

[h2]New areas[/h2]

We'll add new areas to the game!

[h3]Beasts' Path[/h3]

A forgotten and wild piece of Verdant Halls. Beasts of all sorts took shelter here throughout the centuries of abandonment. Atrocious animals and even magical beasts can be found, without much effort in searching. The place is a jungle inside the mines

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/526a9a7d720d4e59f8a7ad6d9e07fc7f61ba7ada.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/b9f837bb07e166b4188bbbb3d1c85a54214e2b47.png[/img]

[h3]Elemental Caves[/h3]

Rifts to the outermost elemental planes have been heedlessly opened for decades by the Elemental Cults of Dorvgrad. The result is an absurd population of Elementals of all types and powers roaming these caves. They say that in the most desolate parts of the Elemental Caves, some ancient elementals live.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/8203c628e5a11eb560acfd1ca9d71887df6f502d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43305512/835d2609b8f88e60a3a59145f1a384d06116bb5b.png[/img]

After you finish the Elemental Caves, you'll go to the usual third area, which is the Ancient Prison. As you can see in the screenshots, there will be [b]new enemies[/b] in those new areas and [b]new bosses[/b]! 

Also, we're working on bringing 68 new equipments, including weapons, armors and accessories!

As you can see, this is a VERY ambitious update, with a million parameters to take into account for the balancing, new assets to produce, testing...

This means that we're now aiming to release this big update for early 2025. We apologize for the delay, and hope you'll enjoy it!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hello Miners,

today we have a brand new update for Forgotten Mines, bringing some much-needed bug-fixing! We also want to thank you all the players for reporting the issues, that has been very helpful to fix them.

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where .exe could be read as malware, due to an embed .pck file. Now the .pck file is exported separately alongside the .exe.
[*]After finding [spoiler]Rayk[/spoiler] once, the player will always have information on his location.
[*]Corrected soft-lock with passive healing. 
[*]Fixed corrupted save in descent mode after heroes reach lvl6
[*]Fixed a bug where, when restarting the game in animal form (wolf or bear), the Druid would lose maximum HP.
[*]It is no longer possible to buy a poe stone after refreshing the items.
[*]Fixed the price of the poe stone 
[*]The player can now change the name of their units on the new game screen.
[*]Fixed a bug where, when the inventory was full and battle was restarted, an "error" sound was emitted.
[/list]

We also want to thank you all for the very positive reviews, and we've now reached the 100 reviews threshold! 

If you still have bugs/issues about your game, please give us as much info as possible so we can investigate on them as best as we can! :) Our immediate objective is the stability of the game and get rid of the remaining issues.

Thank you for your patience!

If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Good day Heroes!

Today, we have a brand new patch for Forgotten Mines, bringing some much-neede bug fixing!
[list]
[*]Hero can no longer be revived because of perks with passive regeneration causing softlock. 
[*]If you change equipped item while one of your character is on an item on the ground, the unequipped item will no longer be lost. 
[*]Fixed hero keeping bonus HP from leveling up after restarting battle. 
[*]Fixed some text going out of bounds in some languages. 
[*]Some adjustments have been made to the reroll button. The button should no longer disappear after too many rerolls. Persk should no longer reroll in the same two perks. If there is only two possible perks, the button will no longer be displayed. 
[*]Controller: Fixed a bug that duplicated items when equipping them. 
[*]Controller : A feedback has been added to the "diamond to gold button" in the guild screen to show the player the button is selected.
[*]Fixed Vsync to no longer be turned on after restarting the game.
[/list]

We're still working on fixing other reported bugs, one of the most urgent ones is the issue where players sometimes lose their equipments after restarting the battle. 

If you still have bugs/issues about your game, please give us as much info as possible so we can investigate on them as best as we can! :) 

Thank you for your patience!

If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Post release bug fixing is on the way
notes.notes:
Hello Heroes!

It's such a pleasure to write this blogpost as Forgotten Mines [b]released exactly one week ago[/b] and you've welcomed it the best way possible. I'm incredibly grateful for your positive reviews and precious feedback!

Talking about feedback, I've been actively working on fixing the bugs you've reported and rest assured, those nasty bugs will be fixed in no time [i](well, give me a few days)[/i]. As for the Steam Deck players, I understand your concerns and apologize for the issues you're experiencing. I'm working on a solution, but it will require a bit more time. Thank you for your patience.

Anyway, as a solo dev, your support means the world and I want to extend a [b]HUGE thank you[/b] to everyone. You're helping me shape the best version of Forgotten Mines. 

Constructive feedback is extremely valuable, so if you have any thoughts to share, please do. I'll be happy to read you! And if you enjoy the game, please [b]consider leaving a review[/b]; that'll help me immensely.

Thank you for reading! If you want to chat with me and discuss strategies with other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!

notes.title: Forgotten Mines will release in July!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Heroes!

I am beyond thrilled to finally share the official launch date of my tactical RPG. Mark your calendars and get ready to delve into the harsh world of Forgotten Mines on [b]July 23rd[/b]!

Set up your team, start your run, kill all the monsters in the room and pray to get the best possible equipment for your Heroes!

Enjoy the brand new [b]trailer[/b] for the occasion:
[previewyoutube=tL8BkHE1GFY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]What you should expect from Forgotten Mines[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Tactical Combat:[/b] engage in intricate tactical battles where [b]every decision matters[/b]. Position your Heroes carefully, find the enemies' weaknesses, and use the environment to your advantage!

[*] [b]Roguelite Elements? No way![/b] Yes way! Randomized levels and permadeath ensure that each run is unique. More replayability!

[*] [b]Diverse Classes:[/b] fighters, wizards, healers, archers and the list goes on. Each with their own unique abilities and skills! [b]Customize your team[/b] to suit your playstyle and find endless strategies.

[*] [b]Find & Buy Equipment:[/b] everything you equip will grant you different bonuses and sometimes, penalties. Pick wisely!

[*] [b]Enemies to Slay:[/b] each room a new challenge. From Goblins to Orcs and other dangerous foes, you better [strike]catch[/strike] slay them all. Unlock the enemies in the game's [b]Compendium[/b] and don't forget to share yours!

[*] [b]Boss Rooms:[/b] at the end of each floor, you will face epic boss battles. Powerful adversaries with unique abilities will try and slay your entire party, good luck with that!
[/list]
Thanks for reading, I'm excited for you all to play the game!
Until July 23rd, you can of course [b]wishlist the game[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2238630/Forgotten_Mines/

If you want to chat with me and other players, you can join the [url=discord.gg/pFreZSEgxQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/forgotten_mines][b]Twitter[/b][/url]!
